cleanup: Latch failure before any close. Stop ordinary operations globally, cleanup attempted owned resources in reverse source order within protected original terminal capacity. Every cleanup begins its slot before effect and is attempted at most once; failure retains original live/unknown handle. Complete cleanup does not make failure eligible. No fd/path exists in the wire union unless actually acquired/attempted; missing observation never means not-created.
consumer_schemas: Before promotion no caller accepts DevelopmentFailure-v3 as preparation failure; dispatch_preparation_v2 handles the new closed PrepOutcome union directly. Existing later postlaunch DevelopmentFailure stays byte-exact. FourFinalReport.add_preparation_failure_v2 accepts actual failed handle without report Pin if publication failed, and adds a truthful in-memory refusal row while attempting bounded durable reporting. No runtime success is claimed when durable report is missing.

contract_identity_v3.after_capture_failure: Preparation failures keep the same readonly contract identity. Unknown later resources and cleanup errors stay on original handles and budgets; no contract recapture, replacement owner or second admission.
contract_identity_v3.before_capture_failure: No successful admission return and no PreparationHandle, pair nonce or arm filesystem effect. The existing actual parent retains the raw first and all failed/unknown publication/close effects; use the already selected postselection FailurePrefix/original-owner path when its required diagnostics can actually be captured. If failure publication also fails, retain actual private failure custody without a fabricated wire Pin. Do not emit PreparationFailure with a null, constituent, planned, computed-but-unpublished or future contract identity.
contract_identity_v3.canonical_bytes: Use unchanged EARLY_ISSUER_CONTRACT.canonical_identity.bytes: exact builtin values, sorted keys, comma/colon separators, ensure_ascii=false, one LF; no duplicate keys, nonfinite/NUL/surrogates. Pin is length/SHA256 of those exact complete captured bytes.

consumers.DevelopmentCoordinator.dispatch_preparat: Validate captured identity and same handle on either branch; only complete PreparationSuccess promotes same pair.
consumers.FourFinalReport.add_preparation_failure_: A preparation outcome must have the real earlier identity; pre-contract failure uses existing earlier failure route and refuses both arms without inventing PrepOutcome.
consumers.PreparationReporter.capture_failure_v2: Bind mandatory development_contract to handle.contract.identity_pin, not profile_pin or policy_pin; preserve raw custody if output fails.
consumers.backend and programme consumers: Original profile/policy/request/exposure/launch fields and paired source identities continue to match the same preparation handle; no wire schema is weakened or a runtime qualification inferred.
consumers.prepare_pair_v2: Require exact private contract token, identical original owner/admitted_open and captured identity bytes; compare every fixed field to actual authenticated inputs before pair nonce/PreparationHandle.

contract_identity_v3.cost_snapshot: Identity has no cost field or publication receipt inside itself. Its construction/capture charges remain live on original H; later PreparationOutcome/FailurePrefix report the actual carried prefix including attempted identity publication. No capture proves its own completed cost.
contract_identity_v3.current_source_boundary: Original inputs/development_contract.py has no identity capture today. This is a concrete proposed caller/field addition, not a claim that the paused current implementation supplies it.
contract_identity_v3.earlier_owner: Register one source-owned ContractAdmissionHandle on actual EarlyOwner/ParentCustody before the first new clock/encode/reserve/output effect. It retains raw first/secondary errors, original H Share, input handles, prospective output attempt and original active spans. Missing qualification still refuses before profile/backend reads as the original source does.

fixed_projection.agent_policy: contract.policy_pin, exact earlier plan.agent_policy and profile.agent_policy.
fixed_projection.environment_values: Exact fifth contract.input_pins item, equal authenticated profile.environment_values; no new environment hash/projection.
fixed_projection.owner_binding: Actual admitted_open/owner.parent.binding_pin; identical completed EarlyOwnerBinding, not a supplied replacement.
fixed_projection.selection: Exact completed EarlySelection Pin from the same actual EarlySelectionAdmission.authenticate_open_v1 return and fourth CreationCapture; parent.selection is authenticated.
fixed_projection.whole_envelope: contract.whole_pin, the exact authenticated profile.whole_envelope input Pin used by the original admission.
fixed_projection.worker_envelope: contract.worker_pin, the exact authenticated profile.worker_envelope input Pin used by the original admission.

order: Consume the actual same-owner authenticated selection-open return. Original dependency/source/native selection and five input captures/joins must all succeed; original environment limits remain.
Construct the exact private DevelopmentContract from those actual values, but do not return it as preparation authority yet. Retain it on ContractAdmissionHandle.

Reserve all encoder, retained metadata, bounded create/write/close/readback/diagnostic work from original H host share within original plan maximum_output_bytes, output file count and deadlines. No new resource grant.

Fixed publisher writes once to source-owned H output-root slot development_contract_identity.json, distinct from either future workspace/private backend control root. Anchored nofollow/create-exclusive identity and original output-store ownership are required; no overwrite or caller path.

Authenticate the complete readback of the exact body, bind the capture and Pin to that same private contract and actual admitted_open, then return the fully admitted same object. Its identity_pin/identity_capture are readonly source-owned fields; a wire Pin cannot construct the object.

Only then may prepare_pair_v2 consume that actual object and same identity capture, allocate pair nonce/PreparationHandle and begin either arm. PreparationSuccess and PreparationFailure use precisely that captured identity Pin.
contract_identity_v3.producer: Prospective fixed admit_development_contract_v3(original owner, original input Store, actual admitted_open, selected profile/policy/qualification, actual original H output Store) retains the original source validations before fixed DevelopmentContractPublisher.capture_v1. No provider/callback is accepted.
contract_identity_v3.source_identity: The five constituent pins are exactly original DevelopmentContract.input_pins order [profile,policy,worker,whole,environment]. Full bytes of each earlier authenticated input remain authoritative; derived public/filtered objects are not substitutes. Pinning the profile also pins its backend/native/source/clock/source selection fields; no qualifier or object is inferred from a hash.

cost: All orchestration/shared publication/reporting costs stay H; per-arm workspace/state work stays exact preselected arm allocation. No inactive interval charged as a new span; open span starts/unknown dimensions remain. Original host terminal reserve pays failure publication; unused arm capacity never transfers. Handle promotion carries identical spent/reserved/cost objects and original deadlines.
entry: DevelopmentOwner.prepare_pair_v2 receives only the fully admitted same private DevelopmentContract returned after contract_identity_v3 publication/readback. It verifies the original actual admitted_open/owner and immutable identity capture before pair nonce allocation or PreparationHandle creation. Existing pre-handle failure and all original operation/cleanup order remain.
full_scope: All original 266 roles/47 APIs/43 owners/65 open gates and five W stages unchanged.
observation_children: WorkspaceObservation.filesystem_identity and inventory require exact typed OwnedPathIdentity/WorkspaceInventory bodies. Every completed capture Pin is independently read back under its original payer before becoming known; provisional bytes are not a completed output. Inventory cannot introduce authentic data outside the already authorized participant view.

ordered_operations.order: paper_data then paper_data_author_code; both use equal predeclared ceilings; one failure prevents every later noncleanup operation
pair plan; both requests; both exposures; both launch requests; promotion only after all exact captures; no worker before promotion

output_bindings.all_other_operations: output must be null; identity only actual complete OwnedPathIdentity for identify operations; fields remain absent/null if capture failed
output_bindings.publish_failure: PreparationFailure or optional exact unchanged FailurePrefix, selected fixed caller only
output_bindings.publish_pair_plan: DevelopmentPairPlan, exact two prepared arm handles
output_bindings.publish_workspace: WorkspaceObservation, with exact OwnedPathIdentity and WorkspaceInventory

ownership: Only exact successful mkdir/create returns establish owned paths; unknown return retains attempted path and parent anchor as ambiguous, never deletes a preexisting path. open/identity failure retains prior owned parent. Removal requires same original parent anchor + observed inode/device/kind equality; identity mismatch refuses removal and records unknown. No recursive unrestricted delete, path-only cleanup or ownership transferred from another arm.

arm_fields.fds: actual retained descriptor handles, never serialized authority
arm_fields.unknown_ownership: retained attempted resource when syscall or post-effect observation is ambiguous
arm_fields.workspace/control: null or actual parent-anchored owned handle with observed identity

private_handle.construction_failure: If even handle registration/allocation fails, existing actual EarlyOwner retains raw first and operation reservation; the existing postselection FailurePrefix route is attempted under its terminal share with last_phase=development_prepare, no pair/launch pin required. No filesystem effects have begun. This is the precise only pre-handle escape; no replacement owner or invented handle.

fields.arms: exact two mutable ArmPreparationState objects in Condition order
fields.contract: Actual fully admitted contract object plus its same earlier identity_capture/identity_pin; no constituent-pin alias.
fields.raw_first: null or the actual original caught exception object

private_handle.slot: Reserve bounded slot and exact operation cost before effect; mark attempted before calling the operation. The actual return/exception updates that same slot. A failed diagnostic clock cannot erase start, result or raw exception; missing times remain null.

producer_consumer.failure: same retained handle + optional captured PreparationFailure; no throw that discards the handle
producer_consumer.success: actual same promoted handle + captured PreparationSuccess
only promoted same handle with complete two launch captures

producer_consumer.failure: capture closed PreparationFailure before optional unchanged FailurePrefix. FailurePrefix.known_records contains only actual completed preparation/failure captures; original_owner_failure identifies actual first failure if capture exists.

PreparationReport with actual outcome; both paired programme rows required_unscorable; no ProgrammeSeal; exact original error/cost/unknown states included. Failed report publication returns actual private failure handle with absent Pin, never fabricates report success.

programme_output_current_composition.prior_text: V1 operative bodies and the full final peer are immutable history, not competing current clauses.
programme_output_current_composition.wire_continuity: Original102 and all12 ProgrammeOutputV1 record bodies plus ProgrammeArgument remain exactly unchanged. ProgrammeOutputV2 adds DevelopmentWorkspaceClosure, HStreamSideV1 and HStreamCaptureV1 plus exact existing CostPrefix/clock/owner/caller relations. Existing schema literals are not a version fallback.

capture_registration.completion_variable: pair_completion: actual PairCompletionHandle returned by its original registered producer
capture_registration.constructor: The private fixed ProgrammeCaptureHandle constructor registers exactly once on that actual PreparationHandle before P01 capture validation/clock/I/O. A prior populated slot, copied handle, foreign predecessor/owner or raw failure refuses with original custody. PairCompletionHandle itself gains no inferred slot and is never reconstructed.
capture_registration.inverse: The capture retains pair_completion by identity; its predecessor slot must still be that same capture. Both original DevelopmentAttemptHandle objects, pair_plan, contract, owner, meters, workspace anchors and captured records are reused exactly. Promotion is on that same capture only after both completed seals.
capture_registration.predecessor: pair_completion.pair: the exact original extensible PreparationHandle; same object as owner.parent.preparation and same originally promoted preparation
capture_registration.source_status: Prospective constructor/caller adaptation, not a claim that the selected source already implements it. No dictionary, Pin, callback, RootBootstrapAdmission or BackendAgentCompletion constructs authority.

programme_output_v2.earlier_ABI: Original full admitted contract must authenticate AgentPolicy.programme_capture_ABI and its actual closed ProgrammeCaptureABI before arm creation/first development effect; compare fixed source code members and source-qualified static bindings. ABI is identical across arms. No output code/formats selected after seeing results.
programme_output_v2.qualification_hold: Existing H/native/context/root/static-source and source-closure-target gates stay mandatory. An ABI declaration/SourceCaptureReceipt never grants missing RootBootstrapAdmission or actual worker launch success.
programme_output_v2.same_original_E: The earlier retained H E exists before preparation; its source operand is owner.parent.original_deadline and is copied to original launch.evidence_deadline_ns without renewal. No pair completion, workspace closure or programme seal is required before original preparation effects.
programme_output_v2.workspace: Prepare the fixed manifest destination as an initially absent path inside each already-owned workspace; record disjoint source namespace and exact preexisting allowed inventory. Preserve anchor/parent ownership through paired lifecycle closure for capture. No arm-controlled root replacement, new output_root or new asset ownership. Workspace closure closes all original writers/descendants; it does not delete the readable source tree or release H read custody. Keep the original readonly/read-custody anchor or a separately qualified actual original-parent reopen capability through both-arm captures, inventories, receipts, seals and assembly. No path reconstruction, new root, renewed worker write authority or inherited-asset access is permitted. Removal/release occurs only in original H terminal cleanup after the full capture/assembly route no longer needs it, under the same E and original budgets.

raw_custody: Catch the first actual exception before calling clock/budget/logger/encoder/cleanup. Retain that exception by object identity on handle/owner. Every later observation/publication/cleanup error appends secondary metadata and actual raw reference in original order, bounded by reserved slots; exhaustion latches unknown and keeps raw owner custody. FailureObservation is diagnostic, not a substitute for original exception.
success_joins: Promotion consumes no new nonce and creates no new state/budget/workspaces. All WorkspaceObservation and InitialStatePreparation fields equal their actual arm captures. PairPlan/request/exposure/launch join those exact captures and same earlier authenticated selection. launch fields cannot be filled from future live backend state.
wire: PreparationFailure or PreparationSuccess is a snapshot of the same handle. Arms exactly Condition order, no duplicated arm; operation ordinals contiguous from0 and actual attempted prefix only, cleanup slot references actual earlier owned/attempted handle. Pair plan/request/exposure/launch Pins nullable iff corresponding capture did not finish; missing pins do not erase an actual partially written file. process_started=false is enforced by the pre-promotion caller barrier. Mandatory development_contract is exactly DevelopmentContractIdentity-v1 from contract_identity_v3. A failure before its completed capture never enters this PrepOutcome union.
